visualContract.density: quiet ground plane with broad low-contrast masses and sparse authored details

layers.rule: For compact dioramas, render the base once as a continuous ground plate. Do not repeat V4 as a production tile: its 3x3 repeat proof still shows visible join lines.
Use irregular overlays sparingly over the grass base; choose compacted/worn near gates, feeding, and vehicle traffic; dry near house approaches; mud only near troughs and wet high-traffic ground.
Orient and place path ribbons to connect real destinations. Let the irregular edge overlap pasture; do not use isolated brown rectangles or let roads terminate at arbitrary points.
Place the art-authored decal below the ground-contact anchor of house approaches, animal clusters, gates, troughs, and tractor paths. Preserve asset-authored contact shadows.

transitionLogic.grassToDirt: Use the V2 irregular alpha road ribbon with its authored grass fringe over the base. Connect both endpoints to a destination or scene edge.
transitionLogic.compactedGround: Use a low-density alpha patch at gates, feeding points, and vehicle approaches; reduce frequency before reducing opacity.
transitionLogic.dryGround: Place a sparse dry-state patch around consolidated house/service areas, not as a full-field replacement.
transitionLogic.mud: Keep mud localized near troughs, watering points, and handling areas.
transitionLogic.cultivated: Use as a separate scene zone or a sparse irregular alpha overlay; legacy full-diamond brown tiles remain excluded.
transitionLogic.repetition: Use one uninterrupted base plate for the current compact diorama. V4 is not seamless at repeated grid joins; do not hide this with large-scale overlap.

placementRules.depth: base ground, path and soil decals, object grounding, then props ordered by ground-contact anchor
placementRules.scale: Use preferredRenderSizePx and logical footprint metadata; fit candidate ground imagery to a scene footprint only after alpha-crop review.
placementRules.repetition: V4 repeat proof is currently failed; use as a single base plate only. Seed variation is required for future repeated base tiles.
placementRules.approval: All V3 family assets remain review candidates until 3x3 repeat, alpha-edge, transition, and scene-fit checks pass human visual review.

review.repeatProof: failed-for-auto-repeat; candidate still has diagonal tonal join lines
review.scenePlate: passed-for-static-pilot-review; repeated appearance is avoided by a single compact ground plate
